calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, take the negative three-day return (reversal) and activate it only when the cross-asset absolute deviation of daily returns from the cross-sectional median is above its trailing 60-day median. Cross-sectionally median demean the active signal before ranking. Uses completed prices only.

validation.method: Daily cross-sectional Spearman IC against next-day close-to-close forward returns; each date requires at least 8 valid tradable instruments.
validation.regime_notes: Daily predictive power was positive and above both gates across sampled regimes: 2020-2022 IC/ICIR 0.057174/0.164549; 2023-2024 0.043035/0.121606; 2025-2026 0.043298/0.125519; 2026-07 onward 0.032011/0.099599. Predictive decay is evident by 10 days. Small cross-section implies conservative uncertainty interpretation.
